new_claims.statement: If W is independent of (Y,Z), ||p_W||<=K and ||p_(Y,Z)||<=H, then 2aWY+F(Y)+b(Z+theta(Y))^2 has density <=3*2^(2/3)(HK)^(2/3)|a|^(-2/3)|b|^(-1/3).

An exact spectral null-ray bank of Parseval mass L yields Q=2sY(W+sqrt(1-L)R)+aY^2+2bYZ+kappa Z^2, with W independent of the complementary product source, (R,Y,Z) an orthogonal projection when L<1, s^2|kappa|=|det Lambda|, and total bank triple-determinant mass |det Lambda|L.
If the exact null-ray bank has L=1, then ||p_Q||_inf<=3*2^(5/3)|det Lambda|^(-1/3)<9.525 under the target normalization.
